heading: Four things, done well.
subtext: Residential plumbing across NW Portland and the Westside — drains, water heaters, repipe and leak repair, and 24/7 emergency dispatch. Flat rates on the common stuff, written estimates on the bigger projects.

cards.title: Drain Cleaning & Hydro Jetting
cards.body: Branch drains, mainlines, and root-intruded sewer lines. Cabled, jetted, and scoped — so you actually see what was wrong. Branch drains $189 flat.

cards.title: Water Heaters
cards.body: Tank, tankless, and heat-pump. Same-day failure replacement when I have a unit in the truck. Standard 50-gal gas install $1,650, electric $1,890, code-correct.

cards.title: Repipe & Leak Detection
cards.body: Acoustic, infrared, and moisture mapping to find the leak before any drywall comes out. Targeted repairs and full PEX repipes on older Westside homes.

cards.title: 24/7 Emergency Service
cards.body: Burst pipes, mainline backups, water heater failures. Direct line to me — typical 30 to 60 minute arrival inside Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, and NW Portland.
